title: Store a short list
summary: PHP: Store a short list. Add fish and read position 2.
introduction: An array can keep values in order. Its first numbered position is zero.
learningObjectives: Store a short list with PHP

blocks.text: Install PHP 8.2 or later. Save each example as lesson.php and run php lesson.php. These are local programs, not a server for this learning site.
The array puts cat at index 0 and dog at index 1. Index 1 therefore gives dog.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Position 1 is the second item, not the first.
